sim08_team_conditioned_late_clock_refere.classification_evidence: Fourth rollout endpoint look. Neither admissible closing ground nor positive control bound established. Fixed-selection uncertainty excludes neighbor selection and alpha selection.
sim08_team_conditioned_late_clock_refere.description: Fixed-selection late-game scoring-transition elapsed discrepancy, selected simulator transitions minus a stabilized actual-game reference.
sim08_team_conditioned_late_clock_refere.notes: 67 matched transitions across 66 rollouts and 40 of 96 scheduled games; reference has 56 transitions in 55 games. Training-only alpha=32, 589 games from 2009-2014; validation 2015-2017. 2000 paired game-identity and seed bootstrap draws. Timeout omitted from matching and imbalance remains. Raw exact discrepancy=1.9402985074626866 seconds. Diagnostic only; no serving change. Bundle manifest SHA256=f69145aa9e1dc994498994013a50fbc305ada6b3d8076da7433c11c9196a2ae3.
sim08_team_conditioned_late_clock_refere.plain_summary: Late-game scoring plays in the simulator take about three quarters of a second less than comparable real plays; the remaining uncertainty is too large to resolve the difference.
